reference:
I keep going back to the conversation I had with my sister on Thursday. I can't figure out if I'm overreacting or if she said something genuinely unfair.

She said I always make everything about myself. It stung, but maybe she has a point. She said that last month, when she was talking about her work situation, I turned the conversation back to me within two minutes. I don't remember doing that — but that doesn't mean I didn't.

The part that bothers me most is that I don't want to be that person. I genuinely care about her and I thought she knew that. But maybe showing up and caring, and actually listening, are different things. I think I need to work on being present — not just waiting for my turn to talk.

I want to call her and apologize, but I'm scared it'll turn into another fight if I bring it up again. I don't know what the right move is.
